title: Launch-week questions
instructions: Open the questions new account managers ask most.

items.title: Who signs off a campaign before launch?
items.text: The account lead approves budget and targeting; the client approves creative. Both approvals are recorded in Orbit CRM before anything goes live.

items.title: Can I change a live budget?
items.text:
Yes, within ±20% per day without asking the client. Larger changes need a written OK:

- Note the reason in Orbit CRM
- Tell the client the same day
- Check pacing again after 24 hours

items.title: What if tracking breaks?
items.text: Pause conversion-optimised campaigns first, then open a tracking ticket. Spend without tracking teaches the bidding algorithm the wrong lesson.

items.title: When do clients get reports?
items.text: Every Monday by 10:00 local time. Northwind Outdoor also gets a short mid-week note during launches (illustrative schedule).
